Sprite.Title: Sprite Animation
Sprite.InvalidGrid: Open the matching source image and enter grid dimensions from 1 to 8192 pixels.
Sprite.CellLimit: A sprite palette can contain at most 512 cells. Increase the grid size or remove unused cells.
Sprite.FrameLimit: A track can contain at most 4096 clips.
Sprite.GridGenerated: Placed {0} cells left-to-right, top-to-bottom on the selected track.
Sprite.TimelineEmpty: Double-click a cell to append it to the selected track.
Sprite.TimelineHelp: Click to scrub; drag clips to reorder or their right edge to resize. Diamonds are transform keys: drag to retime. Ctrl+wheel: zoom. Lower tracks render in front.
Sprite.ReplaceTimelineNotice: Replace the selected track's {0} clips with the grid cells? The palette, transform keys and other tracks will be retained.
Sprite.CompositionHelp: Drag a part to create or update its position key at the playhead. X is right, Y is up; cells pivot at their center. Wheel: zoom; middle/right drag: pan.
Sprite.PartLimit: An animation can contain at most 32 parts.
Sprite.KeyLimit: A part can contain at most 256 transform keys.
Sprite.InvalidPose: Enter finite position, rotation and nonzero scale values within the supported limits.
Sprite.InvalidComposition: Check the source size, unique part names, cells, clips, transform keys and FPS. Each visible part needs at least one clip.
Sprite.CreateCompositionFirst: Use Create sprite node to create a layered animation. The existing single-sprite node has not been overwritten.
Sprite.SourceNotOpened: Select a connected texture. If Sprite Editor is already open, finish or close that draft first; its source and edits were not replaced.
Sprite.ContextChanged: The document, graph, history or target changed. Reload the selected sprite, or reopen Sprite Editor for a fresh draft. No graph changes were applied.
Sprite.ThumbnailNotice: Engine-generated 128 px thumbnail; framing or padding may differ from the texture. Click a cell to select a static frame.
Sprite.FrameBindingNotice: A connected Frame input overrides these settings. Local files cannot be transferred to the engine; select an engine texture.
Sprite.MaterialNotice: The Unreal sprite preview uses a generated material. Custom sprite materials are not supported.
Sprite.TextureSizeUnknown: Unknown — open the source image to edit exact pixel rectangles.
Sprite.DragToAddCell: Drag a rectangle on the source image to add a named cell.
Sprite.DrawHint: Drag to create; drag inside to move; resize at the lower-right handle.
Sprite.CanvasHelp: Wheel: zoom · middle/right drag: pan · Space: play/pause · arrows: step · Delete: remove cell
Sprite.NoCellSelected: Select or draw a texture cell.
Sprite.InvalidCellInput: Cell edits must use a unique name and a positive rectangle inside the source image.
Sprite.OpenSourceBeforeDrawing: Open the matching source image before drawing pixel rectangles.
Sprite.CreateCellFirst: Create a cell before adding a frame.
Sprite.InvalidSequence: Fix the source image size, cell rectangles, frame references, FPS and playback range before applying.
Sprite.SourceSizeMismatch: Saved cells expect {0} × {1} px, but the opened source is {2} × {3} px. Rectangles cannot be edited or applied.
Sprite.InvalidSavedData: Saved sprite animation data is invalid: {0}
Sprite.LegacyGrid: Legacy uniform grid (used only when no named cells are authored)
Sprite.LocalPreview: Local image is preview only; Apply uses the selected engine texture.
Sprite.InvalidImage: Choose a PNG or JPEG up to 16 MiB and 8192 × 8192 pixels.
Sprite.Loaded: Loaded settings from {0}. Select that texture in the catalog before applying.
Sprite.SelectNode: Select a sprite, CPU Particle or GPU Particle node first.
Sprite.InvalidSettings: Enter valid columns, rows, FPS and an in-range frame.
Sprite.Applied: Sprite settings applied as one undoable edit.
